answer: To resist sybils, each agent locks a stake-backed sonnet whose fourteen-line meter embeds a challenge hash unique to its join epoch. Unlocking earnings then requires surviving a tundra cooling window where random sparrow probe agents fire live reverse-derive queries. Clone farms collide on sonnet fingerprints and fail sparrow probes they cannot answer in real time; the cost is N sonnet stakes plus N minds held through the tundra.
